title: Turmeric Poha-Style Rice Flakes with Peas and Peanuts
summary: A vegan Indian breakfast inspired by poha, made with fluffy rice flakes, turmeric, sweet peas and crunchy peanuts. It is gently spiced, bright with lemon and quick enough for a weekday morning.
steps: Put the rice flakes in a sieve and rinse briefly under cold water until damp and softened but not mushy. Drain well and leave to sit for 5 minutes while you prepare the aromatics.
Heat the vegetable oil in a wide frying pan over medium heat. Add the mustard seeds and cook for about 30 seconds, until they start to pop.
Add the peanuts and fry for 2 to 3 minutes, stirring often, until lightly golden and fragrant.
Add the onion, green chilli and ginger. Cook for 4 to 5 minutes, until the onion is soft and just starting to turn golden at the edges.
Stir in the turmeric, then add the peas, salt and sugar. Cook for 2 to 3 minutes, until the peas are hot and tender.
Add the softened rice flakes and gently fold everything together so the flakes turn evenly yellow. Cook for 3 to 4 minutes over low heat, stirring carefully, until hot and fluffy.
Turn off the heat and stir through the lemon juice and chopped coriander. Taste and adjust salt or lemon if needed, then serve warm.
